name: check pet vaccination records and approve boarding bookings with AI

parameters.content:
## check pet vaccination records and approve boarding bookings with AI

### How it works

1. An owner submits a boarding booking on the hosted form with pet details, stay dates and vaccine expiry dates. The entry is validated and the kennel is emailed if details are missing.

2. A deterministic check compares rabies, DHPP and bordetella expiry dates against the stay. Each booking becomes approved, conditional (a vaccine expires around the stay) or blocked (a record is missing or expired).

3. An AI assistant writes the owner reply for the outcome: a confirmation, a nudge to renew one vaccine, or a request to send an updated record.

4. Every booking is logged to Google Sheets. Conditional or blocked bookings also alert the kennel inbox so staff can chase the record.

5. A daily 07:00 watch emails owners whose pet has a vaccine expiring within 30 days. On Monday at 09:00 an AI digest summarizes the week.

### Setup steps

- Create the Google Sheet (tab Bookings) with the columns used in the Google Sheets nodes and paste the spreadsheet id into those nodes.

- Add Google Sheets, Gmail and an [OI] compatible chat model credential (gpt-4o-mini or similar) and select them in the nodes.

- Set the kennel inbox in the Normalize Booking node (kennel_email) so internal alerts reach the right mailbox.

- Publish the form and share its link, then activate the workflow.

### Customization

- Change the required vaccines or the 14 day borderline window in the Check Vaccine Validity node.

- Change the 30 day heads up window or the digest schedule in the schedule triggers.

options.systemMessage: You are the front desk assistant at a pet boarding kennel. Write a short email to the pet owner about their boarding booking request. Use ONLY the supplied details. If the decision is approved, confirm the stay dates and welcome the pet by name. If it is conditional, confirm the booking but clearly ask them to renew the vaccine that expires around the stay before drop off. If it is blocked, politely explain which vaccination record is missing or expired and ask them to send an updated record before the stay. Keep it under 140 words, plain paragraphs, no markdown, no em dashes. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys: subject (max 10 words) and body (the full email).
